curfew_rules: All students must report to their respective hostel blocks before 10:00 PM.
Biometric / Turnstile punch is mandatory at entry and exit.
Late entry between 10:00 PM and 10:30 PM is recorded in the Late Register and requires warden explanation.
Entry after 10:30 PM requires prior written permission from the Chief Warden and intimation to parents.

library_pass_extension.requirement: Valid digital library exit slip endorsed by the Central Library security.

daily_outing.procedure: Biometric punch-out at the security gate.

night_out_pass.application_deadline: Before 06:00 PM on the day of travel
night_out_pass.approval_flow: Student submits via portal -> Automated SMS/Email sent to registered parent -> Warden approves upon parent confirmation.
night_out_pass.check_in_on_return: Must report to warden's office before 10:00 AM next morning or by arrival time stated in out-pass.

vacation_checkout.procedure: Clear all mess and hostel dues, get room inventory signed off by Caretaker, hand over room key to reception.

general_conduct_rules: Strict zero-tolerance policy against ragging under UGC guidelines.
Quiet hours are observed from 11:00 PM to 06:00 AM in all corridors and study halls.
Guests/visitors are only permitted in the Visitors Lounge between 09:00 AM and 07:00 PM. No unauthorized visitors allowed inside student rooms.
Possession or consumption of alcohol, tobacco, narcotics, or contraband substances is strictly prohibited and subject to immediate expulsion.
High-power heating appliances (immersion rods, induction plates, room heaters) are prohibited in rooms.
